text:
lina_cs: Quick heads-up 7 Ember alpha cohort activation blitz idea. Enrollment sitting at 7/20 and two orgs flagged as 'at-risk' for renewal. Thinking: targeted in-product tour + 1x short office hours + a small usage incentive. Thoughts?

jasmine_csm: +1 on office hours. For incentives we did $500 credit last time and saw a bump. Could try a smaller tiered credit ($150 for 1 admin activation + 2 users onboarded).

Derek: I can spin up a 20m live demo focused on embedding search + low-latency rerank. Prefer to keep lab pre-built so customers can run it in 10m.

oliver_pm: We should A/B the email subject lines and call-to-action. Two variants: "Hands-on lab: get your first rerank in 10m" vs "Unlock 2x search accuracy w/ Ember embeddings". Track CTR + signups.

maya_enable: I can own the in-product tour flow (annotated screenshots + copy). Also can author a short checklist for admins to reduce time-to-value. Will need copy review by EOD Thu.

lina_cs: Good. Jasmine, can you list the two at-risk orgs and confirm the TAM/ARR so we size the incentive?

jasmine_csm: Ember-Intl (ARR $18k) and Ember-Data (ARR $42k). Both low WAU and no feature usage of rerank. I'll DM proposed messaging.

Derek: Snippet idea for lab: small node example that uploads docs, creates embeddings, then calls rerank. I'll keep it <25 lines and include env var usage.

oliver_pm: I'll build the A/B email draft and a short landing page with the session agenda + RSVP. Add a 3-question post-session pulse: 1) Did you ship a test? 2) Are you likely to increase seat count in 30d? 3) Top integration blocker (free text).

maya_enable: For EMEA, want a second session at 17:30 UK time. I can run the replay and host live Q&A too.

opsbot: calendar draft created: Ember activation blitz 7 lab + office hours sessions. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/ember-blitz-9876

lina_cs: Action checklist: Jasmine - confirm two orgs outreach copy + approval for tiered credit (today). Oliver - email A/B drafts + landing page (tomorrow AM). Derek - lab snippet + repo link (EOD). Maya - in-product tour + EMEA slot (Thu EOD). Lina - tag accounts with renewal risk and monitor CTR.

jasmine_csm: Approval request submitted to finance for tiered credit; flagging Ember-Intl as high-touch.

Derek: Dropping lab repo link: https://drive.redwood.com/ember-labs/quick-rerank (will add snippet and README by 6pm).

oliver_pm: :thumbsup: I'll add utm params for the A/B lanes so we can track conversions.

lina_cs: Let's reconvene Fri 11am PT to review signups and finalize the two incentive recipients. If we see poor signup rates, we'll escalate a 1:1 outreach plan.

opsbot: thread will auto-archive after 7 days of inactivity.
